title: Central's shared Codex app-server holds 23 per-thread MCP sets (about 2.6 GB private), possibly not released when delegation threads are archived
outcome: Central's shared Codex app-server holds 23 per-thread MCP sets (about 2.6 GB private), possibly not released when delegation threads are archived
acceptance: Each MCP set under the shared app-server is mapped, read-only, to its parent session and thread, and the count belonging to finished or archived work is recorded with evidence.

If any belong to finished work: when a thread is archived or its session ends, its MCP servers exit, shown by a behaviour test on the production path with no timing threshold, on Windows and Linux; if none do, the item records that and closes.
